# TOTO 2 4M configuration fixture

`config.json` contains the unmodified 592-byte Apache-2.0 official configuration
for `Datadog/Toto-2.0-4m` at revision
`8306a9801cf98c0f5ffe4b2dcc8f496e616d84d9`. No model code or weights are included.
Tests create inert weight bytes and a fake runtime.

Source and exact hashes are retained in the
[S6 verification record](../../../docs/s6-toto2-verification.md). License source:
[official model card](https://huggingface.co/Datadog/Toto-2.0-4m).
